title: When Roles Fail: Epistemic Constraints on Advocate Role Fidelity in LLM-Based Political Statement Analysis
reasoning: The research focuses on epistemic stance and uses the Aristotelian rhetorical framework (Logos, Ethos, Pathos) to analyze political discourse. It specifically investigates normative framing, epistemic roles, and references Popperian epistemology as an explanatory mechanism for model failure modes.
